show.description: Rosie is a secretary, but she never wanted to remain just that. She dreamed of rising higher, so she made a plan. Did Siddharth and Priya get trapped in her plan? What exactly is Rosie’s true goal? To find out, watch “Secretary Rosie” only on Kuku TV
